title: Property-Based Testing in R, Powered by Hegel
text: hegelr drives libhegel, native Rust engine. engine never linked install time; loaded runtime. Run download published engine — single prebuilt library file (e.g. libhegel-windows-amd64.dll, sha256 verification) — hegeldev/hegel-rust releases hegelr’s cache directory. use local build instead (example one built cargo hegel-rust checkout), point HEGEL_LIBHEGEL_PATH library: libhegel 0.32.x required; hegelr checks engine version load. R 4.1.0 newer required.

title: Property-Based Testing in R, Powered by Hegel
text: ’s quick example write Hegel test: test fail run devtools::test() (R CMD check). Hegel produce minimal failing test case us: Hegel reports minimal example showing sort incorrectly dropping duplicates. remove sorted[!duplicated(sorted)] line my_sort(), test pass (’s just comparing standard sort ). Reproduce : line replays saved failing example without full run: pass blob property hegel_reproduce().
code: library(testthat) library(hegelr)  my_sort <- function(x) {   sorted <- sort(x)   sorted[!duplicated(sorted)] # drops duplicates: a bug! }  test_that("my_sort matches the reference sort", {   hegel_test(function(tc) {     x <- tc$draw(g_vectors(g_integers()))     stopifnot(identical(my_sort(x), sort(x)))   }) }) draw_1 <- c(0, 0) Reproduce with: hegel_reproduce("AXicY2VgYGBkZOBiZEBhMAAAAd8AIQ==", property) identical(my_sort(x), sort(x)) is not TRUE hegel_reproduce("AXicY2VgYGBkZOBiZEBhMAAAAd8AIQ==", function(tc) {   x <- tc$draw(g_vectors(g_integers()))   stopifnot(identical(my_sort(x), sort(x))) })

title: Generate doubles — g_doubles
text: Draws doubles [min, max], backed engine's generate_float primitive (64-bit width). allow_nan allow_infinity default NULL, resolved per family rule: NaN range unbounded ends, infinities least one end unbounded. title: Filter a generator's output — g_filter
text: Repeatedly draws gen inside FILTER span. predicate rejects value span stopped discard = TRUE, reverting engine's choices attempt, draw retried. 3 rejected attempts (family cap, per Rust Go bindings), generator signals hegelr_assume, rejecting test case (case counts INVALID, exactly like tc$assume(FALSE)); engine's filter_too_much health check real guard -filtered generators.

title: Filter a generator's output — g_filter
code: g_filter(g_integers(0, 100), function(x) x %% 7 == 0) #> $draw #> function (tc)  #> { #>     for (attempt in seq_len(HEGELR_MAX_FILTER_ATTEMPTS)) { #>         hegelr_start_span(tc$context, tc$handle, HEGEL_LABEL_FILTER) #>         value <- gen$draw(tc) #>         keep <- isTRUE(predicate(value)) #>         hegelr_stop_span(tc$context, tc$handle, !keep) #>         if (keep) { #>             return(value) #>         } #>     } #>     stop(hegelr_condition("hegelr_assume", sprintf("g_filter rejected %d draws in a row; rejecting this test case",  #>         HEGELR_MAX_FILTER_ATTEMPTS))) #> } #> <bytecode: 0x56245c0ef080> #> <environment: 0x56245c0f9518> #>  #> $label #> [1] "g_filter(g_integers(min = 0, max = 100), predicate)" #>  #> $empty #> numeric(0) #>  #> attr(,"class") #> [1] "hegelr_generator"

title: Install the libhegel engine — hegel_install
text: Downloads prebuilt libhegel engine library (single file libhegel-windows-amd64.dll) Hegel releases GitHub (https://github.com/hegeldev/hegel-rust/releases) tools::R_user_dir("hegelr", "cache")/libhegel/<version>/. file stored canonical name (hegel.dll, libhegel.libhegel.dylib), hegel_library_path() finds automatically. release publishes .sha256 sidecar asset, download verified (requires R >= 4.5; skipped message older R). function needs jsonlite package (soft dependency) read GitHub API response, network access. GitHub API requires User-Agent header; hegel_install() sends every request. GITHUB_PAT GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable set, value sent bearer token, raising API rate limit 60 unauthenticated requests/hour.

what: Resolve the path of the libhegel engine library — hegel_library_path
title: Resolve the path of the libhegel engine library — hegel_library_path
text: hegel_library_path() locates native libhegel engine without loading . Candidates tried order: HEGEL_LIBHEGEL_PATH environment variable, points existing file. Installs managed hegel_install(): highest-versioned libhegel/<version>/ directory tools::R_user_dir("hegelr", "cache"). installed.rds marker (written hegel_install()) honored first; otherwise directory searched recursively libhegel., libhegel.dylib hegel.dll. title: Run a property-based test — hegel_test
text: hegel_test() drives Hegel engine property, plain R closure taking one argument: test case object tc. Inside body: tc$draw(gen) draws value generator (g_integers(), g_vectors(), ...); randomness must come draws engine can shrink replay. tc$assume(cond) rejects current case cond TRUE (case retried, failed). tc$note(msg) records message shown failure report. tc$target(value, label = NULL) reports targeting score engine's target phase, guiding generation toward larger scores. stop(), stopifnot() testthat expectations fail case. case's outcome maps engine status: body returns normally VALID, hegelr_assume conditions INVALID, budget exhaustion OVERRUN (engine signals hegelr_stop_test draw budget runs ), error INTERESTING - counterexample shrink report. includes testthat expectation failures, inherit error. run fails, hegel_test() replays shrunk counterexample draw reporting, signals condition class hegelr_failure (inheriting error). message lists failure's draws numbered assignment lines, optional reproduce hint, property's error message; multiple failures get count headline:   condition carries blobs, draws notes fields programmatic use. verbosity = 0 reduces report failing call sites.

title: Run a property-based test — hegel_test
text: property function taking single argument (test case). test_cases Number test cases aim (whole number >= 1). Defaults 100. seed Optional fixed seed (whole number, |seed| <= 2^53), making run deterministic; negative values wrap like two's complement cast, matching Go binding. derandomize Use fixed seed derived database key instead random one. NULL (default) defers engine, enables derandomization CI environments; pass TRUE/FALSE decide explicitly. database TRUE (default): persist failing examples tools::R_user_dir("hegelr", "cache")/examples/, stable location (engine's default depends working directory); hegelr disables database automatically CI, like Hegel bindings. FALSE: disable database. directory path string: use directory. verbosity Engine verbosity, NULL (default) engine default, whole number 0..3. verbosity >= 2 test case's draws notes shown runs; verbosity = 0 (quiet) reduces failure report failing call site. phases engine phases run: NULL (default) , character vector subset "explicit", "reuse", "generate", "target", "shrink" (named per official bindings' Phase enums). E.g. phases = c("reuse", "generate") disables shrinking; phases = "generate" runs freshly generated examples. single_test_case Run exactly one generated test case shrinking, replay, example database (Go binding's WithSingleTestCase(), Rust's Mode::SingleTestCase). Useful long-running workloads bodies safely re-runnable inputs; draw note output shown case. suppress_health_checks NULL (default) character vector health checks disable: "filter_too_much", "too_slow", "test_cases_too_large", "large_initial_test_case". report_multiple_failures Keep generating first failure surface additional distinct bugs (grouped origin). Defaults FALSE (stop first failure).

title: Run a property-based test — hegel_test
code: if (hegel_library_available()) {   # Passing property: sorting is idempotent.   hegel_test(function(tc) {     xs <- tc$draw(g_vectors(g_integers(-100, 100), max_size = 20))     stopifnot(identical(sort(xs), sort(sort(xs))))   })    # Failing property: the classic sort-with-dedup bug. Hegel shrinks it   # to a minimal counterexample (two equal elements); the example   # catches the failure and prints it.   my_sort <- function(x) {     out <- sort(x)     out[!duplicated(out)] # silently drops duplicates: the bug   }   tryCatch(     hegel_test(function(tc) {       xs <- tc$draw(g_vectors(g_integers(-100, 100), max_size = 20))       if (!identical(my_sort(xs), sort(xs))) {         stop("my_sort() does not match base::sort()")       }     }),     error = function(e) cat("caught:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")   ) } #> caught:   draw_1 <- c(0, 0) #> Reproduce with: hegel_reproduce("AXicY2VgYGBkZOBiZEBhMAAAAd8AIQ==", property) #> my_sort() does not match base::sort()

text: Runtime loading native libhegel engine (never linked install time): hegel_library_path(), hegel_version(), hegel_library_available(), hegel_install() download published engine sha256 verification; HEGEL_LIBHEGEL_PATH supports local builds. engine version gated: libhegel 0.32.x required (hard error older major.minor-incompatible engines, -per-process warning patch drift). hegel_test(): property runner. Engine-driven generation, integrated shrinking, persistent example database (disabled automatically CI, like bindings). Settings mirror official bindings: test_cases, seed, derandomize, database, verbosity, phases, single_test_case, suppress_health_checks, report_multiple_failures. Test cases support tc$draw(), tc$assume(), tc$note(), tc$target(). Failures raise hegelr_failure conditions carrying minimal counterexample’s draws, property’s error message, reproduce hint, blobs/draws/notes fields; failures grouped call site, like official bindings. hegel_reproduce() replays stored failure blob; stale blobs raise hegelr_stale_blob errors. Composable g_* generators: g_integers(), g_doubles(), g_logicals(), g_raw(), g_text(), g_characters() (single codepoint), g_from_regex(), g_emails(), g_urls(), g_domains(), g_vectors(), g_lists(), g_tuple(), g_one_of(), g_sampled_from(), g_just(), g_map(), g_filter(). testthat integration: properties plain R closures usable inside test_that() stop(), stopifnot(), testthat expectations.
